title: A Multi-Instance Coordinator Document holds strategy that spans Instances, which per-Instance configuration cannot express
content:
A.6.1.1.8.2.6.1.2 adds a document type that appears nowhere else in Launch Agent 7's Artifact: a Multi-Instance Coordinator Document, which "provide[s] general specifications of the Launch Agent 7 Liquidity Layer and define[s] Launch Agent 7's overarching strategy and operational framework for managing across all Instances."

Every other primitive in the Artifact is described purely bottom-up: a Hub Document that indexes Instances, and Instance Configuration Documents that each carry their own parameters and process. That works while Instances are independent. It breaks down for allocation, where the interesting decisions — how much to allocate where, how positions interact, what the aggregate exposure is — are properties of the *set* of Instances, not of any one of them.

The Coordinator Document is the structural answer: a place for cross-Instance policy that sits beside the Instance directories rather than inside any Instance. Without it, shared strategy would have to be duplicated into each Instance and would drift, or would live outside the Artifact entirely and escape the Root Edit review path.

Its placement is also a scoping statement. Because the Coordinator lives under the Allocation System Primitive, the Liquidity Layer is formally part of that primitive's implementation rather than a free-standing piece of Agent infrastructure.
description: Introduced only for the Allocation System Primitive, it carries the Liquidity Layer's general specifications and the overarching framework for managing across all Instances at once.
